name: Aisyah binti Rahman
bio:
Aisyah has been immersed in the world of finance since graduating from the University of Malaya with a degree in Accounting. Her career began at a local auditing firm, where she honed her skills in financial analysis and reporting. Aisyah's passion for motorsport began as a child, watching Formula 1 races with her father. She saw an opportunity to combine her financial expertise with her love for racing and made the transition to Century Motorsport five years ago.

As Finance Controller, Aisyah is responsible for managing the team's budget, ensuring financial compliance, and identifying cost-saving opportunities. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to make sound financial decisions under pressure. Aisyah's dedication to the team and her proactive approach to problem-solving make her an invaluable asset to Century Motorsport. She believes in transparency and open communication, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone understands the financial implications of their decisions. 

Aisyah is particularly skilled at navigating the complex financial regulations of international motorsport, ensuring the team remains compliant while maximizing its competitive advantage. She's also surprisingly good at predicting material costs, having developed a knack for anticipating market fluctuations.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, usually worn in a neat ponytail
physical.description: Aisyah is of average height with a warm, friendly smile and a composed demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas or calculations.
Starts every day with a cup of Teh Tarik.
Has an uncanny ability to remember obscure financial regulations.
